title: A Free Lunch: Gradient Averaging Achieves Optimal Statistical Efficiency in Newton Sketch
abstract: arXiv:2611.23671v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study statistical inference for online sketched Newton methods, in which each Newton system is approximately solved by an inner randomized sketching solver. Existing work reveals a computational--statistical trade-off: the sketching solver (and its accelerated variants) reduces the per-step cost of Newton methods from $O(d^3)$ to $O(d^2)$, but the randomness introduced by sketching also inflates the limiting covariance of both the last and the averaged Newton iterates. In this work, we address this trade-off via gradient averaging. We show that simply replacing the stochastic gradient with a moving average at each step can mitigate, and in some cases eliminate, the trade-off in Newton sketch. Importantly, gradient averaging requires no additional oracle evaluations and leaves the contraction bound of the inner sketching solver unchanged. translated_title: 免费的午餐：梯度平均使Newton Sketch达到最优统计效率
translated_abstract: 我们研究在线草拟牛顿方法的统计推断问题，其中每个牛顿系统由内部随机草拟求解器近似求解。已有研究揭示了一种计算—统计权衡：草拟求解器（及其加速变体）将牛顿方法每步的计算成本从 O(d^3) 降低至 O(d^2)，但草拟所引入的随机性也会增大最后迭代点和平均牛顿迭代点的极限协方差。在本工作中，我们通过梯度平均来解决这一权衡。我们证明，仅仅将每步的随机梯度替换为滑动平均，就可以缓解、甚至在某些情况下消除 Newton sketch 中的这一权衡。重要的是，梯度平均不需要任何额外的预言机评估，并且不会改变内部草拟求解器的收缩界。特别地，我们证明了带梯度平均的最后草拟牛顿迭代点可以达到……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明，在草拟牛顿方法中仅需将随机梯度替换为滑动平均（无需额外计算开销、不改变内部求解器收缩界），即可缓解甚至消除草拟带来的计算—统计权衡，实现最优统计效率。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that simply replacing stochastic gradients with moving averages in sketched Newton methods—requiring no extra oracle evaluations and leaving the inner solver's contraction bound unchanged—mitigates or even eliminates the computational-statistical trade-off induced by sketching, achieving optimal statistical efficiency.
